## How the lessons work

::: {.feature-row}
::: {.feature}
**Words first**
Every lesson starts with new English words and their Arabic meaning.
:::
::: {.feature}
**See, then try**
Pictures and simulators come first. Math and code come after.
:::
::: {.feature}
**Practice often**
Short "Try it" tasks after every idea. Check your answers.
:::
::: {.feature}
**Web or paper**
Use the web page in class. Print the PDF to study at home.
:::
:::
